scope: Static ASM kernel evidence for the converted Form surface subtype t_spl_sur

facts.meaning: Calls exact_spl_sur::restore_data, then t_spl_sur::impl::restore_data. t_spl_sur derives its stored geometry from exact_spl_sur
Restores the subtrans subtype through dispatch_restore_subtype, reads the region index with read_size_t and compares it with t_spl_subtrans_object::region_count
After spl_sur::restore_common_data it loads the bs3 surface pointer at offset 0x30 and calls sys_error(0xfde9) at 0x3a8de0 when the pointer is null
Calls exact_spl_sur::save_data, then writes the region index
Calls spl_sur::check, t_spl_subtrans_object::compatible and t_spl_subtrans_object::bs3_srf_synced for the stored bs3 surface
The 35 t_spl_sur symbols include no member named eval, evaluate, param, point_perp or approx. Evaluation is inherited from the exact bs3 surface
Reads the bs3 knots, then calls test_discontinuity at 0x3a5940 and 0x3a59f4. test_discontinuity at 0x201410 compares derivatives with resnor and resabs tolerances
A procedural parameter-space intersection curve subtype exists. The local Form bodies use exact_int_cur boundary curves instead
